messages:
Maria: Drafted a short Regulated‑Ready Snapshot (1 page) for security/SLA + deployment advice. Quick ask: can someone sanity check tech language and approve the CTA? Link: https://docs.google.com/document/d/abc123
Sam: On it. I skimmed — looks tight. Two quick recs: add a 1‑line benchmark (p95 latency + cost/unit) and a single sentence about rollback/fallback behavior.
Jonah: +1 on the benchmark. For the webinar tie‑in we should use the brief as the post‑webinar leave‑behind. Suggested webinar subject line: "How to run LLM inference with enterprise SLAs and secure deployments" — short variant in code block below.
Jonah: ```Email subject A: Secure inference at scale — SLAs & deployment options
Email subject B: Meet regulatory needs for LLMs: SLAs, VPCs, and fallbacks
``` 
Claire: I can map the inbound routing. Proposed lead rules (low/no fluff):
Claire: ```
# inbound routing pseudo-config
rules:
  - if: lead.tags contains "security" or lead.industry == "finserv"
    assign: field-sales-enterprise
    priority: high
  - if: lead.request contains "on-prem" or lead.request contains "VPC"
    assign: solutions-engineering
    notify: legal-ops@redwood.com
  - else:
    assign: growth-qualification
``` 
Claire: Also suggest adding an SDR note when form selects "SLAs required" -> attach the brief automatically.
Sam: For the brief CTA: keep it utility focused. Two options:
Sam: "Get a tailored SLAs & deployment guide" or "Request a secure deployment scoping call". I prefer the first for gated capture.
Maria: Great. Can someone add the benchmark callout? Jonah, can you draft the 2‑line benchmark and a 30s talking point for the webinar? Claire, can you push the routing snippet to the inbound playbook? Target: finalize by EOD Thursday. :thumbsup:
Jonah: I can drop the benchmark and the 30s talking point by noon tomorrow.
Claire: Will add routing to playbook and create the SDR auto‑attachment. ETA tomorrow afternoon.
Sam: I'll patch the doc with CTA variants and a microcopy option for the download form.
Maria: Perfect — thanks everyone. Ping me when done and I’ll schedule the social post + product blog cross‑post.
LaunchBot: Event scheduled: "Regulated‑Ready Snapshot review" on Thu 11:00 AM (calendar invite sent to Maria, Sam, Jonah, Claire).
